Chaos Bolt.name: Chaos Bolt
Chaos Bolt.description: Caster makes a ranged attack roll, launching a bolt of pure chaotic energy at 1 + 1/2F targets, inflicting a random chaos effect on hit.

Chaos Control.name: Chaos Control
Chaos Control.description: Twisting chaos into a powerful force, caster grants the effects of Primordial Sphere (Turmoil - 0) to 4 + 2/F targets; while also removing any active chaos effects, HEA save to negate both effects. Caster determines what resistance is given upon casting. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Chaos Curse.name: Chaos Curse
Chaos Curse.description: Chaotic energy surrounds the targets, undermining their senses, WIL save to negate. Whenever the target attempts to make an attack roll or cast a spell, roll a d6. On a result of 4-6, the caster may choose a new target for that attack or spell by expending a reaction. The spell is still treated as though the target cast it. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Chaos Shield.name: Chaos Shield
Chaos Shield.description: In reaction to being struck by an attack roll, the caster strikes back with a brilliant flash of energy. The target takes 3 + 1/F d12 chaotic damage and is targeted by a chaos effect (lasting 1 + 1/F days), HEA save for half damage and to negate the chaos effect.

Chaos Inversion.name: Chaos Inversion
Chaos Inversion.description: Reaching out towards the essence of the target, caster exchanges what languages and origin skills are known between themselves and the target, caster loses access to any languages and origin skills they currently have and gain whatever languages and origins skills the target has for the duration of the spell. This can instead be used on a written or electronic document to scramble it beyond any recognition, by forcing the document to randomly alternate between the grammatical and written intricacies of the languages they comprise. This can be used on non-sentient targets.

Chaos Incarnate.name: Chaos Incarnate
Chaos Incarnate.description:
Chaotic forces coalesce to protect the target. At the casting of the spell, roll 1d4. Apply an effect to the target according to the result from this table; lasts until the start of the target's next turn: 
1: Until the start of their next turn, the target is immune to mundane damage 
2: Until the start of their next turn, the target is immune to elemental damage 
3: At the start of each of their turns; target gains a 40 HP barrier 
4: Attack rolls against the target suffer two displaced rolls and they receive two placed rolls to all saves and resistance checks.

Disordered Alignment.name: Disordered Alignment
Disordered Alignment.description: Chaotic energies violently attempt to fuse the targets, sending them both to an isolated but safe 80' radius area in the plane of chaos, causing them to share 1 + 1/F year's worth of random memory, and to become immediately hostile to one another for the duration, WIL save to negate all effects. The caster must always be one of the targets, and all targets are returned to the location they were in previously, or the nearest safe location.

Erratic Odds.name: Erratic Odds
Erratic Odds.description: Instead of rolling 2d10 on attack rolls, resistance, skill, and attribute checks, the character rolls 1d6, WIL save to negate. On a 4-6, the attack roll/save/skill check is considered a success (If it is reasonable), on a 1-3 it is considered a failure. In the case of resistance check setting, 4-6 sets the resistance check to 25; 1-3 sets the resistance check to 2. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action. This spell cannot be dropped until it's duration expires.

Ignition.name: Ignition
Ignition.description: As a reaction to a skill check, save/check, or attack roll, roll 1d4. Caster may choose to add this to the rolled value.

Meteoric Acceleration.name: Meteoric Acceleration
Meteoric Acceleration.description: Willing targets sacrifice their body and mind in exchange for power. They become vulnerable to all effects and have 2 displaced rolls on all resistance checks. At the end of the initiative, targets receive another Core, Movement and Swift Action that they may use as they wish. This spell cannot be dropped before it's duration expires.

Outer Chaos.name: Outer Chaos
Outer Chaos.description:
The caster draws upon the realm of chaos to aid in shaping the battlefield, gaining a selection of random components to reshape surrounding terrain. To determine your selection of components, roll (4 + 1/F)d6 and gain components from the following table in accordance with each die's value: 
1: A 5'x1' steel battlement. A character standing behind this item gets exceptionally protective cover but may make ranged or melee attacks through it. 
2: Two 5'x5', 10' deep pitfall traps. The trap is covered in earth, though a successful awareness check will detect it. When a character steps on it, they must make an AGI save or fall in. A character unaware of the trap gets a displaced roll on this save. These may not be placed on occupied spaces. 
3: A 10' radius of difficult terrain that inflicts slowed on all characters moving in it 
4: A 10'x30' gust of wind in the caster's chosen direction. A character entering or starting their turn inside of this item must make a STR save or be pushed 10' in the wind's direction. 
5: A 5' radius of fog that grants cover to all characters in it 
6: Three 5'x5', 10' tall blocks of iron wall. These may not be placed on occupied spaces. 
The caster may distribute their components within the spell's area as they see fit. Components vanish in a flash of chaotic energy at the end of the spell's duration

Pandemonium.name: Pandemonium
Pandemonium.description:
The caster summons an apocalyptic storm. At the end of each of the caster's turns, they roll 1d6. All targets in the storm suffer an effect from the following table corresponding to the die's value. 
1: Every target within the storm is pinned by a wave of force, until the end of their next turn 
2: All targets in the storm receive an instance of Chaos Warp. Upon becoming Warped they must cast chaos once every 24 hours or receive the consequences. 
3: Lightning bolts strike up to three different targets of the caster's choice in the storm, inflicting 5d20 damage and inflicting slow until the end of their next turn, AGI save for half damage. 
4: All targets in the storm are stunned until the end of their next turn, AGI save to negate. 
5: All targets in the storm have their HP set to half of it's normal maximum, HEA save to negate. 
6: All targets in the storm at or below half their maximum HP immediately fall unconscious and are put into a forced rest period, as per Stable Unconsciousness.

Primordial Sphere.name: Primordial Sphere
Primordial Sphere.description: Caster surrounds themselves in a sphere of raw chaotic energy, granting themselves their choice of mundane resistance or elemental resistance until the start of their next turn. However, whichever resistance they don't choose, they become susceptible to.

Random Spell.name: Random Spell
Random Spell.description: Caster channels the pure chaotic energies of the universe. Caster must roll a d2 to determine whether it will be elemental: 1, or divine: 2. Caster then rolls a d10 to determine which spell group they will cast from where spell groups are numbered in the same order as the book. Then roll a d6 + 1/F to determine the rank of the spell. At this point the caster may select which spell they wish to cast so long as it is in the proper group at the correct rank.

Reality Tear.name: Reality Tear
Reality Tear.description: Caster rips the fabric of reality open, unleashing primal chaos upon the targets. A random effect is inflicted on all targets that end their turn in the rift by rolling on the chaos chart (This effect lasts for 1 + 1/F Days) in addition to inflicting 4 + 1/2F d12 chaotic damage to them, AGI save for half damage and to negate the chaos effect.

Super Chaos.name: Super Chaos
Super Chaos.description: A glob of ectoplasmic chaos flies towards the target as the caster makes a ranged attack roll, inflicting 8 + 1/F d10 chaotic damage and causing a chaos effect. The caster chooses 2 + 1/F effects within 2 + 1/F of the rolled effect, the caster knows what this effect is. They may not choose the same effect twice and must choose at least one effect.

Unstable Presence.name: Unstable Presence
Unstable Presence.description: The caster disrupts their connection to reality with chaotic energy, causing themselves to phase in and out unpredictably. At the end of each turn, the caster rolls a d6. On a result of 4-6, the caster phases out of reality completely until the start of their next turn. During this time, they are treated as though they do not exist. They may observe the world but not interact with it. On a result of 1-3, the caster suffers a random chaos effect.

Vernal Defense.name: Vernal Defense
Vernal Defense.description: Caster infuses the targets with energy. Willing targets lose their movement action, cannot be moved by magical or mundane means, lose their ability to perform AGI checks, and their movement DVs, but they gain 22 + 1/2F armor DVs. This spell cannot be dropped until it's duration expires.
